bank_name: ICB Islamic Bank Limited (formerly The Oriental Bank Limited / Al-Baraka Bank Bangladesh Limited)
period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported) vs 31-Dec-2023. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (for Q1, cumulative = discrete). SOLO/STANDALONE basis. Source PDF is a scanned filing; OCR (pdftoppm 300dpi -> tesseract 5.5.3) quality is good. Extensively cross-validated: the 31-Dec-2023 comparative column (total assets 10,685,391,288; total liabilities 23,555,314,377; equity -12,869,923,089; deposits 12,316,117,976; investments 7,909,731,309; off-balance-sheet 223,444,841) matches this dataset's own 2023_Q4.json exactly on every field; retained earnings at Dec-2023 (-20,052,098,870) reconciles exactly via the balance-sheet identity (paid-up + statutory + other reserve + retained earnings = equity). The Mar-2023 comparative P&L column (investment income 54,497,703; total operating income -21,912,943; operating expenses 103,017,774; PAT -105,347,840; EPS -0.16; NOCFPS 0.27) matches 2023_Q1.json's own figures exactly. As in other quarters, the source's 'Specific provision (charged)/released' line is printed as a plain positive figure regardless of charge/release direction; the true sign (-16.0m, a net recovery) is derived as C minus the reported PBT. Income-statement chain closes exactly (A-B=C, C-D=PBT, PBT-tax=PAT, PAT/664,702,300 shares=EPS -0.21, matching the filing's own Notes section). A large negative NOCFPS this quarter (-1.40) is explained by the source's own note: a BDT 75-crore repayment of Bangladesh Bank borrowing during the quarter (Placement from banks & other financial institutions fell from 5,537.77m to 4,787.67m).
